description: Figure 8b illustrates accuracy (ACC) as a function of co-occurrence number for Llama2, showing six method curves (Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number,” uses a logarithmic scale with major ticks at approximately \(10^1\), \(10^2\), and \(10^3\), and spans from a few units (leftmost plotted point around 5) to a few thousand (rightmost point around 3000). The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 85, with tick marks at 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, and 85. The Base line is black with circular markers and a solid style, increasing from about 62% at the leftmost point to about 67% at the rightmost point. The FT line is blue with downward-triangle markers and a solid style, rising from about 63% to about 68%. The IKE line is red with upward-triangle markers and a solid style, increasing from about 64% to about 70%. The MEND line is brown with left-pointing triangle markers and a solid style, increasing from about 66% to about 74%. The MEMIT line is purple with diamond markers and a solid style, increasing from about 66% to about 73%. The ROME line is green with square markers and a solid style, increasing from about 72% at the leftmost point to about 78% at the rightmost point, with a smaller change between the last two x positions.
